document_title: Quarterly Large Load Economic Development Reports Q3 and Q4 2025 - REVISED/corrected Public Disclosure versions (errata refiling)
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=225690 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/225690/106952. Unzipped it and took ONLY the public-disclosure (PD) PDF, deliberately leaving the trade-secret (TS) files in the archive untouched. Converted that PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). The text is saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen cleanup, form feeds and column artefacts left in place.
